top_call_exchanges.topic: Q4 2026 $1M Revenue Target & Lunar Outpost Commercial Ramp
top_call_exchanges.question: Can you discuss what provides the confidence to guide Q4 revenue doubling to ~$1.0 million, and how much of that is driven by recurring hardware shipments versus Lunar Outpost development milestones?
top_call_exchanges.management_answer: Matt Fisch (CEO): 'Our visibility into Q4 comes from binding purchase orders and committed program schedules. Lunar Outpost is now contributing under our multi-million-dollar contract as Apollo moves from qualification into flight hardware fabrication. Simultaneously, our lead defense customer placed its fifth order, and repeat commercial orders across our 32 active accounts provide the foundation for this $1M quarterly baseline.'

top_call_exchanges.topic: Gross Margin Progression & STRATOS Counter-UAS Unit Economics
top_call_exchanges.question: Gross margin improved substantially from -80% in Q2 to -33% in Q3. How does the STRATOS revenue mix with Swiftstrike AI impact margin progression into positive territory in 2027?
top_call_exchanges.management_answer: Conor Tierney (CFO): 'The 47-percentage-point sequential gross margin improvement reflects three factors: lower bill-of-materials costs as Apollo reaches volume, lower warranty accruals, and an initial contribution from STRATOS. Because STRATOS incorporates our software-defined architecture, it commands higher software attachment rates and better ASPs. As commercial volumes ramp through 2027, we expect to cross into positive gross margins.'

top_call_exchanges.topic: ATM Utilization, Balance Sheet Cash, and Runway into 2028
top_call_exchanges.question: Ending cash rose to $63.1 million this quarter. Can you detail the capital raised under your ATM facility, your planned cash burn for 2027, and whether additional equity financing is needed?
top_call_exchanges.management_answer: Conor Tierney (CFO): 'We strategically tapped our ATM facility during periods of liquidity to build a fortress balance sheet with $63.1M in cash and marketable securities and virtually zero debt. With full-year 2026 cash consumption guided at $35M and our commitment to reduce burn by ~15% in 2027, our cash runway now comfortably extends into 2028 without requiring near-term capital raises.'
